attempts.text:
**The window opens on a short spine.** Columns 0 to 1, `yghU` to `gss`, are carried by 95 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0.2% of calls. The model names 99 to 100% of them, fewest at column 1, `gss`, 99%.

**A fork opens at column 2**, `pitB`, carried by 76%, with an IS1 family transposase at 38%. A branch of 4 shell families runs through columns 44 to 47, [[polysaccharide export]], 22 to 23%.

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 99.7 against 83%, and hesitates less there, 0.14 against 0.79 bits. It hesitates most at column 2, `pitB`, a fork column, 1.93 bits.

**The window ends on fork columns.** Columns 72 to 79, `cmtA` to `mscS`, are carried by 44 to 36% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 83% of genes**, 0.77 bits on average, perplexity 2.4 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.16 against 0.20 bits, and names fewer genes, 75% against 96%.

label: yghU
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the yghU window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yghU, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 711 to 790 from dnaA. Read in 536 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yghU once); 42,880 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 83% of genes, 0.77 bits on average (perplexity 2.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 17,538 calls, named 97%, 0.27 bits; shell 23,423 calls, named 78%, 0.93 bits; cloud 1,919 calls, named 20%, 3.47 bits. Outside an RGP 17,148 calls, named 96%, 0.20 bits; inside an RGP 25,732 calls, named 75%, 1.16 bits. Columns: 2 spine, 37 fork, 41 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.16 against 0.20 bits) and names fewer genes (75% against 96%); 25,732 of the 42,880 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 2 (pitB, a fork column) 1.93 bits, RGP 92%; column 37 (yqgA, a fork column) 1.54 bits, RGP 68%; column 23 (sslE, a variable column) 1.53 bits, RGP 81%. The 38 columns (columns 2-39) where most calls are in an RGP: named 83%, 0.70 bits on average; the other 42 columns: named 83%, 0.84 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 2 spine columns: named 99.7%, 0.14 bits on average; the 78 fork and variable columns: named 83%, 0.79 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 2, is a fork column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-1 (2 columns) spine: share 95-100%, all P, RGP 0.2%. Genes: yghU "glutathione-dependent disulfide-bon…", gss. named 99-100% (mean 99.7%), fewest named at column 1 (gss), named 99%; most hesitant at column 0 (yghU), 0.20 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 2-79 (78 columns) fork and variable columns: share 14-77%, 41 P, 37 S, RGP 38-92%. named 19-96% (mean 83%), fewest named at column 4, named 19%; most hesitant at column 2, 1.93 bits.
